Game Overview

In Thorn and Blast, the core idea is straightforward: immerse yourself in Thorn And Blast, an exhilarating action-puzzle game where precision and strategy reign supreme. Masterfully aim and strategically shoot to obliterate vibrant thorns with limited shots. As challenges intensify, test your reflexes and wit to conquer increasingly intricate levels, making every victory immensely rewarding.
